title: Project: Contact Book
story: The library desk needs a tiny contact book you can drive with commands.
goal: Read commands until quit. add NAME PHONE saves a contact. find NAME prints the phone, or not found. Adding the same name again replaces the phone.
starter:
book = {}
# read commands until you see quit
hints: Use a while True loop, break on quit, and split each command into parts.
parts[0] is the command. book.get(name, "not found") is a safe lookup.
socratic: How does the loop know when to stop?
What should happen when the same name is added twice?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Project: Contact Book”?
